- Vivek: verify the uplift/credits applied in the ledger; flag anything reclassified as contra-revenue in the last 30 days.
- Laura: assemble the one-page narrative (150–250 words) tying Acme to our bookings corridor and highlight any judgement calls (e.g., co-terming, multi-year discounts).
- Aditya: be ready to produce the audit trail export for Acme (invoice_history_export.csv) and the DocuSign proof of signature if needed.

Timeline: initial answers by Tue EOD PT (2027-03-15 23:59 PT). If there are any items that cannot be closed by then, list them with an owner and expected finish time. We will lock the investor appendix Wednesday morning.

Please reply with short bullets only — status, owner, ETA.

Thanks,
